answer: SELECT s.superhero_name FROM superhero s JOIN publisher p ON p.id=s.publisher_id JOIN hero_power hp ON hp.hero_id=s.id JOIN superpower sp ON sp.id=hp.power_id WHERE p.publisher_name='Marvel Comics' AND sp.power_name='Super Strength'
SELECT ROUND(100.0*SUM(p.publisher_name='Marvel Comics')/COUNT(*),2) FROM superhero s LEFT JOIN publisher p ON p.id=s.publisher_id WHERE s.height_cm BETWEEN 150 AND 180
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM superhero s LEFT JOIN alignment a ON a.id=s.alignment_id WHERE s.alignment_id IS NULL OR a.alignment NOT IN ('Good','Bad')

WITH c AS (SELECT sp.power_name, COUNT(DISTINCT s.id) n FROM superhero s JOIN publisher p ON p.id=s.publisher_id JOIN hero_power hp ON hp.hero_id=s.id JOIN superpower sp ON sp.id=hp.power_id WHERE p.publisher_name='Marvel Comics' AND s.full_name IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(s.full_name) NOT IN ('','-') GROUP BY sp.id) SELECT power_name, n FROM c WHERE n=(SELECT MAX(n) FROM c)

SELECT ROUND(AVG(s.weight_kg)) FROM superhero s JOIN publisher p ON p.id=s.publisher_id WHERE p.publisher_name='DC Comics' AND s.weight_kg>0 AND s.eye_colour_id IN (SELECT s2.eye_colour_id FROM superhero s2 JOIN publisher p2 ON p2.id=s2.publisher_id WHERE p2.publisher_name='Marvel Comics')
note: weight_kg 0 treated as unrecorded (172 rows); counting 0 gives 76

answer: SELECT AVG(weight_kg) FROM superhero WHERE weight_kg>0 AND race_id IS NOT NULL AND race_id NOT IN (SELECT race_id FROM superhero WHERE gender_id=2 AND race_id IS NOT NULL)
note: weight 0 treated as unrecorded; result dominated by Godzilla outlier (90000000 kg)

answer: SELECT g.gender, ROUND(1.0*(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM hero_power hp JOIN superhero s2 ON s2.id=hp.hero_id WHERE s2.gender_id=g.id AND s2.full_name LIKE '% %')/COUNT(*),2) FROM superhero s JOIN gender g ON g.id=s.gender_id WHERE g.gender IN ('Male','Female') AND s.full_name LIKE '% %' GROUP BY g.id
note: full name taken as containing a space

answer: SELECT ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN height_cm>0 THEN height_cm END),1), ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN weight_kg>0 THEN weight_kg END),1) FROM superhero s JOIN publisher p ON p.id=s.publisher_id WHERE p.publisher_name='George Lucas'
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT hp.power_id) FROM superhero s JOIN hero_power hp ON hp.hero_id=s.id WHERE s.gender_id=1 AND s.weight_kg>0 AND s.weight_kg<70

SELECT ROUND(100.0*SUM(a.alignment='Good')/COUNT(*),2) FROM superhero s JOIN publisher p ON p.id=s.publisher_id LEFT JOIN alignment a ON a.id=s.alignment_id WHERE p.publisher_name='Marvel Comics' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hero_power hp WHERE hp.hero_id=s.id)
